summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser and its tests. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and the SHACLPathError exception, and added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed). mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-check gate was not run; type-ignore placement was checked by reading only, and no line exceeds 88 columns. No other files were changed and nothing was committed.
